# Model List

> Review currently available Kimi multimodal and coding models, plus migration guidance for discontinued models.

Click [here](https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/pricing/chat.md) to see more details of model price.

## Multi-modal Model

| Model Name | Description |
| - | - |
| `kimi-k3.1-pro` | The first model of the new K3.1 series and Kimi's most capable flagship to date: a 3T-class model with native visual understanding and a 1M-token context window, delivering substantial improvements in coding, 3D creation, and financial research and modeling. |
| `kimi-k3.1-pro-highspeed` | The high-speed variant of Kimi K3.1 Pro — same intelligence, about 2-3× the speed. |
| `kimi-k3` | Kimi's previous-generation flagship and the world's first open-source 3T-class model (2.8 trillion parameters); with native visual understanding and a 1M-token context window, designed for frontier intelligence scenarios such as long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and deep reasoning. |
| `kimi-k2.7-code` | Kimi's dedicated coding model. It follows instructions more reliably in long contexts, completes coding tasks with higher success rates. Context 256k |
| `kimi-k2.7-code-highspeed` | High-Speed version of Kimi K2.7 Code model, with output speed of approximately 180 Tokens/s and up to 260 Tokens/s in short context scenarios, delivering a more extreme coding experience. |
| `kimi-k2.6` | Supports both visual and text input, thinking and non-thinking modes, and dialogue and Agent tasks. Context 256k |

## Deprecated Models

> [!NOTE]
>
> Dear Kimi Users, starting October 31, 2026, K2 series models will no longer be available to newly registered users; existing users are not affected. We plan to retire all K2 series models by the end of December 2026, please [prepare your migration](https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/kimi-k3-1-pro-quickstart.md) in advance.

> `kimi-k2.5` was officially discontinued on **August 31, 2026** and is no longer maintained or supported. Please use the latest Kimi model [kimi-k3.1-pro](https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/kimi-k3-1-pro-quickstart.md) for continued support and enhanced reasoning capabilities.

> The `moonshot-v1` series models (including `moonshot-v1-auto` and the `-vision-preview` variants) were officially discontinued on **August 31, 2026** and are no longer maintained or supported. Please use the latest Kimi model [kimi-k3.1-pro](https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/kimi-k3-1-pro-quickstart.md) for continued support and enhanced reasoning capabilities.

> The `kimi-k2` series models were officially discontinued on **May 25, 2026** and are no longer maintained or supported. Please use the latest Kimi model [kimi-k3.1-pro](https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/guide/kimi-k3-1-pro-quickstart.md) for continued support and enhanced reasoning capabilities.
